capabilities: Render >>key<< citation markers as author-year citations in Live Preview and Reading view
Generate and maintain a managed References section at the end of each note
Search the BibTeX library by citation key, author, or title and insert citations
Import or select a .bib file from the vault or from the device
Parse BibTeX entries with nested braces, quoted values, string macros, and concatenated values
extras: The formatter is explicitly not a complete CSL or BibTeX implementation; only an APA-like author-year style is provided. The generated References block must not be edited manually.
intentEvidence: It does not require Zotero, Mendeley, an account, or a network connection.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to cite BibTeX works or generate a bibliography from citation keys in a note.
